listing.name: Puella Portrait Pack Plus Chatter Characters (PPPPCC)
listing.summary: Adds portraits and combat chatter personalities for the Holy Quintet from Puella Magi Madoka Magica.

Puella Magi Madoka Magica. What is there to say about it that hasn't already been said? A Starsector portrait pack and

Combat Chatter

submod, that's what. This mod adds ten portraits (the Holy Quintet in both regular clothes and magical girl outfits) and six

combat chatter

personalities (the sixth is a

surprise

). The mod still works if you don't use

Combat Chatter

, you'll just get the portraits only. Editing an officer's name to match a character's name (e.g.: "Kaname Madoka" or "Madoka Kaname" for Madoka) will give them their respective chatter personality. Natural incidence rate for them is lower to account for the fact that they frankly don't have a lot of lines without digging into in-universe stuff or spoilers. That being said, I couldn't avoid all spoilers in this submod, so be warned.

Note: there's another folder in there. It's a joke based on this.

descriptionHtml:
Click on the runes to download!

Puella Magi Madoka Magica. What is there to say about it that hasn't already been said? A Starsector portrait pack and Combat Chatter submod, that's what. This mod adds ten portraits (the Holy Quintet in both regular clothes and magical girl outfits) and six combat chatter personalities (the sixth is a surprise). The mod still works if you don't use Combat Chatter, you'll just get the portraits only. Editing an officer's name to match a character's name (e.g.: "Kaname Madoka" or "Madoka Kaname" for Madoka) will give them their respective chatter personality. Natural incidence rate for them is lower to account for the fact that they frankly don't have a lot of lines without digging into in-universe stuff or spoilers. That being said, I couldn't avoid all spoilers in this submod, so be warned.

Note: there's another folder in there. It's a joke based on this.
